column3: src/camera/camera.ts:18 is the only Camera interface in src; scene-core.ts:163 (camera: Camera | null), render-task-base.ts:225/620 and render/renderable.ts:21 type against it; XrCamera extends it (xr/xr-camera.ts:41)
geospatial-camera.ts:46, free-camera.ts:19, arc-rotate.ts:23 extend Camera+IWorldMatrixProvider+IParentable; banked-free-camera.ts:20 BankedFreeCamera extends FreeCamera

free-camera.ts:38-40 createFreeCamera returns _createFreeCamera(position, target, Vec3Up), and Vec3Up is {0,1,0} (math/vec3-up.ts); banked-free-camera.ts:44 calls _createFreeCamera with its ObservableVec3 up
scene/scene-camera.ts:10-56 works out the mesh world AABB and frames an ArcRotateCamera from radius = diag*1.5; the file is in src/scene

scene-camera.ts:50 (default framing), loader-babylon/parse-camera.ts:12 and loader-gltf/gltf-feature-camera.ts:119 (scene-file loaders) call the factories; no other non-index file calls any create*Camera
defined only at camera.ts:236; viewport.ts:2 is `export { getEffectiveAspectRatio } from "./camera.js"` and has no other definition
camera.ts:88 optional `ortho?` on Camera, type imported from ./orthographic.js (camera.ts:6); getProjectionMatrix branches on it at camera.ts:206

banked-free-camera.ts:17 imports only _markLocalMatrixDirty (used at :43); it hands off no parenting or world-matrix versioning (the shared _createFreeCamera does that). Only free/arc-rotate/geospatial call createWorldMatrixState

arc-rotate.ts:122 target, free-camera.ts:75-76 position/target, banked-free-camera.ts:43 upVector; ObservableVec3 setters call _onDirty (math/observable-vec3.ts); geospatial-camera.ts:211-214 center/position/upVector/lookAt are plain object literals

math/_matrix-allocator.ts:19-44 is F32 by default, F64 once _setHpmAllocator runs (createEngine with HPM); Camera declares _viewCache/_projCache/_vpCache as required (camera.ts:31,35,41) and getViewMatrix/getProjectionMatrix write into them without allocating

not all camera matrices come from them: xr/xr-camera.ts:98-116 (updateXrCameraForView) fills an XrCamera's world matrix and _projCache from XRView.transform/projectionMatrix, using neither the look-at nor the perspective/ortho writer
arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:4 imports runFrameInterpolation from animation/frame-interpolation.js; geospatial-camera-controls.ts:6 imports createPickingRay from picking/ray.js

_rightHanded flips: camera.ts:139 (view Z mirror), free-camera.ts:58, arc-rotate.ts:103, geospatial-camera.ts:222 (basis flip), arc-rotate-controls.ts:438/463, free-camera-controls.ts:106/119, configurable-free-camera-controls.ts:109/120 (input direction)

engine/coordinate-system.ts:1-20 doc: #coordinate-system resolves by bundler condition to coordinate-system.ts (null) or coordinate-system-rh.ts (true), each a const; nothing in src assigns _rightHanded at runtime

identical `if (_rightHanded !== null) for i of [0,1,2,8,9,10] s[i] = -s[i]` in free-camera.ts:58-64, arc-rotate.ts:103-109, geospatial-camera.ts:222-228, one per kind, all tied to the getViewMatrix Z mirror at camera.ts:139

camera.ts:155 `_orthoProjector = null` filled only by enableOrthographicCamera (orthographic.ts:138); arc-rotate-controls.ts:84 `_arcRotateKeyboardFactory` undefined until enableArcRotateKeyboardControls (arc-rotate-keyboard-controls.ts:165-167); comments at camera.ts:151-154 and keyboard :162-163 give tree-shaking as the reason

camera.ts:206-209 runs the perspective writer whenever _orthoProjector is null, whatever camera.ortho holds; _orthoProjector is set only by _installOrthographicProjector, which only enableOrthographicCamera calls (orthographic.ts:138)

arc-rotate-controls.ts:262 reads the factory once at attach time, so keyboardAttachment stays undefined and keyboardAttachment?.[0]()/[1]() (:432,:527) do nothing; the doc at arc-rotate-keyboard-controls.ts:162 says to call it before attachControl

writePerspectiveMat4LHIntoBuffer writes only out[0],[5],[10],[11],[14] (math/write-perspective-mat4-lh-into-buffer.ts:10-14); the ortho writer sets [12],[13],[15]; orthographic.ts:153-155 zeroes those

not all 14 gate GPU uploads: scene/parentable.ts:16 and scene/scene-core.ts:331 name it only in comments, and xr/xr-camera.ts:116 and shadow/shadow-base.ts:251 use it to stamp camera matrix-cache versions (_projVer/_vpVer)

camera.ts:194 inside _cameraChangeKey (fov/near/far poll); orthographic.ts:72 invalidateProjection, called by the bounds setters and by enable/disable (:98,:112,:141,:156); csm-shadow-cache writes coverage._projRev, not the camera's

several files import neither the contract nor a matrix getter: xr/xr-session.ts:11, frame-graph/post-process-task.ts:3, copy-to-texture-task.ts:43, post-process/smaa.ts:62 and effect/effect-renderer.ts:12 import only NormalizedViewport; post-process/ssao/ssao-pbr.ts:22 imports only getEffectiveAspectRatio
scene-core.ts:334-341 syncCameraFloatingOrigin holds the only write; _update calls it at :387 before the _beforeRender loop and again at :391 after it

arc-rotate-controls.ts:496 applyInertia, free-camera-controls.ts:161 update, configurable-free-camera-controls.ts push update, geospatial-camera-controls.ts:760 onBeforeRenderTick (calls _setOrientation), geospatial-camera-fly.ts:143 driver (_setOrientation :124); each one moves the camera

scene-core.ts:436-437 public onBeforeRender unshifts, while every camera control and the fly driver push (and runFrameInterpolation pushes, frame-interpolation.ts:103), so user callbacks run first in the _update loop at :388

without a scene, attachControl's pinch still changes the camera: onTouchMove writes camera.radius directly (arc-rotate-controls.ts:400-401), so input is not 'never applied' for all three attachers; only the inertial and keyboard paths depend on the scene hook
arc-rotate-controls.ts:143-147 says the scene param is unused, kept for backward compatibility; it installs _clampToLimits, which the alpha/beta/radius setters call (arc-rotate.ts:172)

arc-rotate.ts:162-177 defineProperty setters for alpha/beta/radius call cam._clampToLimits?.() right after each change; the hook is clampCameraToLimits, installed by setCameraLimits (arc-rotate-controls.ts:172-174)

scene-change.ts:199-215 pushes the callback onto scene._disposables; disposeScene (scene-core.ts ~600-647) runs disposables and clears scene arrays but never touches canvas listeners; arc-rotate-controls.ts:216-235 documents this use

arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:133-143 step throws when the pose changed between frames; runFrameInterpolation catches it and rejects (animation/frame-interpolation.ts:82-87); an abort also rejects (:96-99)

geospatial-camera-fly.ts:97 Promise has only resolve; finish() (:131-140) resolves and is installed as camera._cancelFly, which a new flight (:76) and controls input (geospatial-camera-controls.ts:480-481) call

geospatial-camera.ts:310-315 the getter returns the internal `center` object; only `set center(v)` calls applyOrientation, so writing center.x etc. skips the clamping, basis and position rebuild and markLocalDirty

free-camera-controls.ts:125-130 and configurable-free-camera-controls.ts:125-130 inside the per-frame update rebuild target from _yaw/_pitch on any frame with movement or rotation; a hand-set target does not update _yaw/_pitch, so the next input frame overwrites it
viewport.ts:23 resolveCameraViewport (public, index.ts:999) clamps with clamp01; camera.ts:242-253 _applyCameraViewport (@internal) does the same flip without clamping

world-to-screen.ts:52-78 validateOptions throws on non-positive/non-finite viewport and backing sizes, non-finite viewport offsets or worldOrigin, and bad CSS sizes; it runs from projectWorldToScreenToRef (:95), while projectPointToViewportToRef (:44-50) checks nothing and allows zero-size viewports. Only options are checked: a non-finite point gives NaN, not a throw
no index export (command prints nothing); geospatial-movement.ts exports are imported only by geospatial-camera-controls.ts:10 (rg across src)
